## Scope

The audit covered 400 second reads taken during the quarter. The review considered the consistency of those reads and the level of agreement achieved across the audit work. The scope was limited to the reads included in the audit and did not extend beyond that material.

## Result

Overall agreement was 66.2 per cent. This result provides the overall measure for the audit and should be considered alongside the individual findings. Per-grader results are available in the attached spreadsheet. Those results will be discussed with each grader privately, allowing the relevant findings to be reviewed directly and any points requiring clarification to be addressed in an appropriate setting.
